fieldEndDay.title: End day
fieldEndDay.waitCashier: The cashier counts again on their own login. You can end the day once they confirm.
fieldEndDay.mismatch: The counts do not match the cash collected. It is on the Bug fixer list; finance resolves it with you.
fieldEndDay.matches: Your count matches the cash collected.
fieldEndDay.nowCashier: Now the cashier counts and confirms on their login.
fieldEndDay.endNote: The day ends only when everything on this phone is sent, the last visit is checked out and the cashier has confirmed your cash. Location stops when the day ends.
fieldEndDay.ended: Day ended. Location is no longer recorded.
